raw_query: I was charged twice this month!! This is unacceptable. Fix this NOW.
reformulated_query: Customer on Pro tier was double charged for the current billing cycle and is requesting a refund for the duplicate charge.
resolution: Verified duplicate charge in billing system. Issued full refund for the duplicate transaction. Refund processed within 3-5 business days. Sent confirmation email to customer.
resolution_steps: Log into admin billing panel
Navigate to customer account CUST-101
Identify duplicate charge under Transactions tab
Click 'Issue Refund' on the duplicate transaction
Select reason: Duplicate Charge
Confirm refund and send automated confirmation email

raw_query: Hey I cant find the Gantt chart feature anywhere in my dashboard. Where is it?
reformulated_query: Free tier customer cannot locate Gantt chart feature. Customer may be unaware this feature is restricted to paid tiers.
resolution: Informed customer that Gantt chart is a Pro and Enterprise exclusive feature. Provided comparison table of features per tier. Offered 14-day free Pro trial. Customer accepted the trial.
resolution_steps: Check customer subscription tier - confirmed Free
Confirm Gantt chart is Pro/Enterprise only per feature policy
Send feature tier comparison document
Offer 14-day Pro trial using promo code PROTRIAL14
Apply trial to account if customer accepts

raw_query: All our project data from the last sprint is gone. We have a client demo tomorrow. This is a disaster.
reformulated_query: Enterprise customer reports complete loss of sprint project data. Situation is time-critical due to upcoming client demo within 24 hours.
resolution: Escalated immediately to Tier 2. Triggered data recovery protocol. Restored data from 6-hour backup snapshot. Data loss window was 4 hours. Customer confirmed recovery was sufficient for demo.
resolution_steps: Flag as P0 - Critical for enterprise customer
Escalate to Tier 2 engineering immediately
Access backup recovery panel for workspace ID
Identify most recent valid snapshot
Restore snapshot to staging environment first
Confirm data integrity with customer
Restore to production after confirmation
Document incident for post-mortem

raw_query: The Slack integration stopped working after your last update. Notifications are not coming through at all.
reformulated_query: Pro tier customer's Slack integration is broken post-update. Notifications are not being delivered to their Slack workspace.
resolution: Identified that the last platform update deprecated OAuth 1.0 tokens. Customer's Slack integration was using an old token. Guided customer to disconnect and reconnect Slack using OAuth 2.0. Integration restored.
resolution_steps: Confirm last platform update changelog - OAuth 1.0 deprecated
Ask customer to go to Settings > Integrations > Slack
Click Disconnect on existing Slack integration
Click Connect Slack and complete OAuth 2.0 authorization flow
Test by triggering a test notification
Confirm receipt on customer end

raw_query: I am locked out of my account. I tried resetting the password but I am not getting the reset email. I have a deadline today.
reformulated_query: Pro customer locked out of account. Password reset emails are not being received. Situation is urgent due to same-day deadline.
resolution: Checked email delivery logs - reset emails were going to spam due to customer domain filtering. Provided manual verification via account backup email. Temporarily unlocked account and sent reset link to alternate email.
resolution_steps: Pull email delivery logs for customer email address
Confirm reset emails were sent but likely filtered
Request customer check spam or junk folder
If not found, request backup email on file
Manually trigger password reset to backup email via admin panel
Set account status to temporarily unlocked for 2 hours
Follow up after resolution

raw_query: The platform is extremely slow when we have more than 50 users active simultaneously. Pages take 10 seconds to load.
reformulated_query: Enterprise customer experiencing severe performance degradation with 50+ concurrent users. Page load times exceeding 10 seconds.
resolution: Identified customer workspace was on a shared server cluster. Migrated to dedicated enterprise cluster. Also enabled CDN caching for their region. Load times reduced to under 2 seconds.
resolution_steps: Check current server assignment for workspace
Confirm workspace is on shared cluster - not appropriate for enterprise scale
Submit internal request to migrate to dedicated enterprise cluster
Enable CDN caching for customer's primary region
Monitor performance post-migration
Confirm with customer that load times are acceptable

raw_query: I want to cancel my subscription but I cannot find the cancel button anywhere.
reformulated_query: Free tier customer wants to cancel their account subscription. Needs guidance on cancellation flow.
resolution: Guided customer to Settings > Billing > Cancel Subscription. Informed customer that free tier has no charges so cancellation only deletes the account. Offered account pause option instead. Customer chose to pause.
resolution_steps: Clarify customer is on free tier - no financial charges
Explain that cancellation on free tier means account deletion
Offer account pause as alternative
If customer insists on cancellation: Settings > Billing > Cancel Subscription > Confirm
If customer chooses pause: Settings > Account > Pause Account > Select duration

raw_query: How do I export all my project data to CSV? I need it for an audit.
reformulated_query: Pro tier customer needs to export all project data in CSV format for an internal audit.
resolution: Guided customer to Reports > Export > Full Data Export > CSV format. Noted that full export for large workspaces can take up to 30 minutes. Customer received download link via email.
resolution_steps: Confirm Pro tier has access to full data export
Navigate to Reports > Export
Select Full Data Export
Choose CSV as format
Select date range or All Time
Click Generate Export
Inform customer they will receive download link via email within 30 minutes

raw_query: We noticed login activity from an IP address in a country we do not operate in. We think our account may be compromised.
reformulated_query: Enterprise customer reports suspicious login activity from foreign IP address. Potential account compromise.
resolution: Immediately forced logout of all sessions. Enabled enhanced security monitoring on the account. Reviewed login logs and confirmed 3 unauthorized access events. Helped customer enable SSO and IP whitelisting. Flagged for security team review.
resolution_steps: Immediately force logout all active sessions via admin panel
Pull login audit logs for the past 30 days
Identify and document all suspicious login events
Lock account temporarily pending customer verification
Verify customer identity via secondary channel
Unlock account and guide setup of SSO
Enable IP whitelisting under Security Settings
Flag incident to internal security team
Send security incident report to customer

raw_query: Is there a way to set recurring tasks? I cannot seem to find it.
reformulated_query: Pro tier customer looking for recurring tasks feature. Need to confirm if feature exists and guide accordingly.
resolution: Confirmed recurring tasks are available on Pro tier. Guided customer to Task Settings > Recurrence > Set Schedule. Customer successfully set up weekly recurring tasks.
resolution_steps: Confirm recurring tasks feature is available on Pro tier
Open any existing task or create a new one
Click the three-dot menu on the task
Select Set Recurrence
Choose frequency: daily, weekly, monthly, custom
Set end condition: never, after N occurrences, or specific date
Save
